subject: Transportation Systems
title: The World's Busiest Ports
description: A quick, practical guide to The World's Busiest Ports.

hook.text: Shanghai handles over 47 million TEUs per year. That's a container every half-second, around the clock.

buildup.text: Singapore, Shenzhen, and Busan round out the top four. All are in Asia—the factory of the world.

discovery.text: Asia dominates because manufacturing concentrated there. Ports grew to match the export volume.

twist.text: Rotterdam is Europe's busiest port but handles only a quarter of Shanghai's volume.

climax.text: Port rankings are a mirror of economic power. As trade shifts, port rankings shift with it.

punchline.text: The world's busiest ports reveal where things are made.

quiz.question: Which is the world's busiest container port?
